address: 601 N. Primrose Dr., Orlando, FL, 32803, USA
bio: This casual barbecue spot in Orlando’s Milk District pairs Texas-style smoked meats with freshly made donuts. What began as a pop-up has evolved into a relaxed, counter-service restaurant with an open kitchen and an unfussy, no-frills atmosphere. The barbecue leans traditional, with smoked brisket, turkey and house chorizo served simply with classic accompaniments. Sides like beans and slaw play a supporting role, and indulgent mashups, like a griddled crepe filled with mac and cheese, reflect a playful side of the menu. The real surprise comes at the end of the meal, however, with made-to-order donuts ranging from simple glazed versions to more indulgent creations, including maple-bourbon glazes and savory-sweet toppings.
